description: Needs a rent.dev account: sign in when your client offers it, or call rent_signup first. For someone who runs a machine, their own or a VPS rented elsewhere, and wants to sell its compute; to get a machine to use, rent a sandbox instead, with rent_create_sandbox on /mcp or POST /v1/sandboxes over REST. What your nodes have earned, in micro-USD (one micro-USD is one USDC base unit): totals and one page of entries, newest first. A lease shows once it settles, never while it runs. Each entry counts in exactly one total, named by its `state`: `pending` (in the holdback, which is longer when the customer paid by card), `releasable` (waiting for its node's next payout), `frozen` (never paid while frozen), `in_payout` (in an open payout, named by `payout_id`), `paid` (the chain shows its payout made). `unaddressed_micros` is the releasable part on nodes with no payout address on the payout network: register one with rent_supply_update_node. `payouts` says whether this environment pays, and on which network, token and wallet. Each node is paid once a day, in USDC, to the address registered on that node; a node without an address is not paid and its releasable earnings wait until one is registered. A payout cannot be reversed, and a payout made is never sent again to another address. rent_supply_payouts lists the payouts themselves. `next_cursor` is only for the next call of this tool.
name: rent_supply_earnings
title: Get your earnings
